title: Sparkly treasure chest
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='wood' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c9803a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a4f1d'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lid' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e39a52'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b06a2c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe680'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0a92a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6b0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd94a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow inside the chest -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='30' ry='9' fill='url(#glow)' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- chest body -->
  <rect x='18' y='52' width='64' height='30' rx='3' fill='url(#wood)'/>
  <!-- body color panels to separate from lid -->
  <rect x='18' y='52' width='64' height='6' fill='#7a4217' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- gold bands vertical -->
  <rect x='24' y='52' width='6' height='30' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='70' y='52' width='6' height='30' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <!-- gold trim bottom -->
  <rect x='18' y='76' width='64' height='6' fill='url(#gold)'/>

  <!-- lid (rounded top) -->
  <path d='M18 52 Q18 30 50 30 Q82 30 82 52 Z' fill='url(#lid)'/>
  <!-- lid gold bands -->
  <path d='M24 52 Q24 34 50 34 Q76 34 76 52 Z' fill='none' stroke='url(#gold)' stroke-width='0'/>
  <rect x='24' y='38' width='6' height='14' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='70' y='38' width='6' height='14' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <!-- lid highlight -->
  <path d='M28 46 Q30 36 50 36 Q68 36 72 46' fill='none' stroke='#f7c98c' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- lock -->
  <rect x='44' y='50' width='12' height='14' rx='2' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='47' y='54' width='6' height='6' rx='1' fill='#8a5a12'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='1.5' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <!-- keyhole glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='61' r='1.2' fill='#fff6b0'/>

  <!-- sparkles around -->
  <g fill='#fff6b0'>
    <path d='M12 22 L14 28 L20 30 L14 32 L12 38 L10 32 L4 30 L10 28 Z'/>
    <path d='M86 18 L87.5 23 L92 24.5 L87.5 26 L86 31 L84.5 26 L80 24.5 L84.5 23 Z'/>
    <path d='M88 62 L89.5 67 L94 68.5 L89.5 70 L88 75 L86.5 70 L82 68.5 L86.5 67 Z'/>
    <path d='M10 66 L11.5 70 L16 71.5 L11.5 73 L10 77 L8.5 73 L4 71.5 L8.5 70 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffd94a' opacity='0.9'>
    <circle cx='20' cy='44' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='80' cy='46' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='24' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='22' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='86' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='88' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='88' r='1.4'/>
  </g>
</svg>
